mapper.select: SELECT id AS "patientId", NULL::text AS "name", NULL::text AS "gender", birth::text AS "birthDate", phone, address, medical_history AS "medicalHistory", allergies FROM patient WHERE id = #{patientId}

SELECT u.id AS "patientId", u.account AS "account", u.name AS "name", u.sex AS "gender", p.birth::text AS "birthday", u.email AS "email", COALESCE(p.phone, u.phone_num) AS "phone", p.address AS "address", p.medical_history AS "medicalHistory", p.allergies AS "allergies" FROM "user" u LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{patientId} AND u.user_type = 'PAT'
